results.notes:
Built WS12-S9, the plane-boundary gate. Three rules over apps/<Plane>/ tracked files: R1 Postgres DSN hosts in docker-compose*.yml and .env.example must be a host the plane owns or a local host (unknown hosts fail too); R2 non-test source has no dblink, postgres_fdw, CREATE SERVER or \connect, and no DSN naming another plane's host or a shared host; R3 Cargo path, go.mod replace and package.json file:/link: must not resolve into another plane's directory. Config is scripts/gates/plane-boundary.json. Exceptions are pinned to one file and one host or target, need a reason, and fail when stale. The shipped list holds only the Quarry SDK manifest exception that the plan documents. The gate's --self-test runs 10 fixtures, each in a throwaway git repo; the unittest module calls it. Enumeration uses git ls-files, like size-ratchet.

The row's DoD says green on the tree, and it is not met. The plan allows only the Quarry SDK path dependency, so I did not add exceptions for the 14 real violations. Those are the owner decisions listed in depth_findings. Blocking mode needs each one fixed or a reviewed exception. Until then the CI gate step stays advisory per the rollout convention. The status is partial for that reason only: the code, tests and deliverable are done.

results.notes: Built the code half only. zdr-live-proof.sh has phases preflight|before|after: preflight checks the four wave services started in order session-core, execution-core, model-gateway, inference-core, each from a revision containing ZDR_WAVE_COMMIT, migrations 0044/0045 and runs.retention_class present, ZDR_WAIVER_ENABLED not literally true on any service (reduced to one word, no other env printed), zero waived runs and zero ZDR outbox rows. before/after bracket the spec with counters (threads, messages, runs, feedback_ratings, session_audit_outbox, ZDR outbox rows, count of mp:gw:cache:* keys via redis-cli --scan, count only) and after fails on any delta. Output is tee'd to docs/compliance/evidence/live-reads-zdr-<date>.txt by default (--out overrides); the script creates that file only when the operator runs it. zdr-live-turn.spec.ts is opt-in (ZDR_LIVE_TURN=1), refuses to send unless the org is named ZDR-TEST with ZDR on and the live catalogue lists no ZDR chat model, then asserts the stream ends in zdr_unavailable or zdr_connection_not_supported with zero content frames and the reader-facing 'not sent to a model' text; handles both HTTP-error and RUN_ERROR-frame refusals. The runbook holds the ordered deploy via rebuild-service.sh, rollback, the before/turn/after sequence, switching the test org back off, and pass 2 pointer. No docker, no live proof, no dry-run against the dev stack was done (lead's). Waiver minting untouched.
